title: The unit cache test isolates the path and text key inputs, so dropping either from _unit_key fails it
goal: In the unit-cache test of _tools/test_live_kb.py (ST-dvzdykit, 3678c14eb), the cases for the unit's path and text change only that input, so a _unit_key that drops u['path'] or u['text'] fails the test; today a changed path also changes the title through its meta and a changed text also misses the expansions, so both drops still pass. Found by the SP-caqrexqw review.
